name: Catherine Sun
text:
Ben helped me get my dream job. My whole work experience had been in big tech, and I could tell that there is a different style of interviewing, communicating, and culture in quant. They were very hands on with prepping me for the interviews, I always felt prepared and confident because of their support. 

They were so on top of things that I found out I was getting an offer the night of my onsite interview. 

Most importantly, I believe they are honest and transparent people. For example, I had a health issue come up when my onsite interview had already been booked. They swiftly communicated with the company and rescheduled my onsite. It was the right decision as I got an offer while still prioritizing my health.  

Thank you for my life changing opportunity!

name: Max D
text: Ben is in a league of his own as a recruiter. An industry veteran with deep connections, he knew exactly which firms were the right fit for me, guided me throughout the entire interview process, and helped me negotiate an offer at Citadel. If you’re exploring roles in quant finance or tech, Ben is the person to talk to.

name: Roy Xiong
text: 10/10 experience with Tyler! Never had a recruiter work with me the way he did. Helped me find the firms that made the most sense for where I wanted to take my career, helped me prepare for the interview process, and made sure I got the compensation package that I needed. Would recommend everyone to work with Tyler.

name: Alex Mott
text: I had a great experience working with Tyler. He introduced me to a variety of firms including some I never would have found on my own. I just started my new job at a startup that Tyler introduced me to, and it is exactly what I was looking for. He was on top of the process from start to finish, from introductions and prep to discussing offer negotiations and keeping on top of the contract. I highly recommend working with him.

name: Junyoung Kim
text: Working with Kunal was a genuine pleasure. He takes the time to understand what you truly want, and his tenacity is unmatched. He kept digging until he uncovered an opportunity that was perfect for me. Thoughtful, relentless, and exceptional at his craft.

name: Colman Seery
text: Lira’s great! She helped narrow my search to trading firms I’d actually be interested in and would not have known about otherwise, had a ton of valuable connections, and provided specific insight at every step of the process. She was responsive, but didn’t call at 7 or 8am like many recruiters in the space. Highly recommend working with her.

name: Ryan Tan
text: Chris's mission is putting the most capable people in the highest leverage positions. It's all too familiar for him, because he himself is the most capable person in the recruiting space I've ever met. But what made Chris great to work with wasn't just his access to some of the most successful and prestigious firms, or his connections and knowledge that made the processes extremely smooth. It was his humility and unending support through every step of the way, a rare experience for me when it comes to recruiters.

name: Scott Taver
text: Arsen was foundational in helping me land my next successful role in engineering. After getting connected he took into account my experience, expertise and desires and routed me effectively to a few different options that all led to screenings. Along the way I greatly appreciated the touchpoints, encouragement and collaboration that led to me choosing a fulfilling role that I would not have come across as I struggled in my own shotgun approach to job searching. It was instrumental to have this support in todays job search.

name: Manik Sethi
text: Arsen is incredibly helpful, going to long lengths to make sure that you are well equipped and prepared for the interview process. With his help and support, I am now working as an Applied AI Engineer at Mercor!
